category_edits.rationale: Assign reverse nonpadding position ranks across all four category models: the final real or masked token receives ID 1, earlier tokens receive increasing IDs, and padding remains 0. This may improve recency alignment across variable history lengths. The generated predictor imports BERT4RecModel from train.py, so it automatically uses the same positional logic without changing checkpoint shapes. Preserve history length 128, appended-mask readout, masked-target training, backbone, scoring, loss and optimizer.

response.change_summary: Replace chronological nonpadding positions with reverse recency ranks in every category’s single BERT4Rec model, consistently shared by training and the generated predictor.
